thought.text: Frontend serves HTTP 200. Let me stop it and test backend startup.

reasoning_content:
Frontend dev server runs and serves HTTP 200. Let me stop it and check the backend. The backend requires Keycloak and DB. The installation guide needs those. Let me try running the backend to see how far it goes. But it will likely fail without Keycloak/DB. Let me check what's minimally needed.

Actually, the task is software installation. The successful build of both backend and frontend, plus frontend dev server serving HTTP 200, is strong evidence. The backend requires external Keycloak and MSSQL database configuration. Let me attempt backend startup to see behavior.

Let me stop the frontend server first.

action.command: pkill -f "ng serve" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "angular" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; ps aux | grep -E "node|ng" | grep -v grep | head; echo "--- port 4200 ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP:%{http_code}\n" --max-time 5 http://localhost:4200/ || echo "stopped"
